home.summary: This archive serves as a curated collection of experiences from over 95 escape rooms across 8 countries, spanning more than a decade of puzzle-solving camaraderie.

featured.summary: Here’s a look at two standout trips and two of our favorite awards that celebrate the escape room culture.

jamie.intro: Jamie approaches each room with a methodical mindset, focusing on systems and team alignment.

mazie.intro: Mazie brings energy and intuition, often unlocking puzzles through creative insights and pattern recognition.

tammy.intro: Tammy contributes her situational awareness and communication skills, ensuring the team stays coordinated under pressure.

tyler.intro: Tyler’s detail-oriented approach helps the team methodically navigate complex puzzles with accuracy.

best-things.intro: Best Things captures our essential picks, reflecting shared insights on rooms that resonate with escape room aficionados.

best-things-twin-cities.intro: Best Things Twin Cities highlights standout rooms in the local scene, featuring places like The Founder's Secret.

escape-in-europe.intro: A journey through Europe with rooms in cities like Amsterdam and Barcelona, rich in variety and design.
escape-in-europe.routeSummary: Starting in Voorburg with Molly's Game, the route winds through Utrecht before heading to Brussels, then to Amsterdam, Paris, and finally Barcelona.

qmsb.intro: This trip focuses on rooms in Quebec, emphasizing unique challenges in cities like Laval and Quebec City.
qmsb.routeSummary: Beginning with The Dreamwalkers in Quebec City, the route covers a mix of creative themes before concluding in Laval.

1-jamies-escape-in-europe-favorites.intro: This is Jamie's personal shortlist of favorite rooms from a recent trip, highlighting standout experiences across Europe.
